_comment: RATCHET BASELINE for scripts/ci/check-editor-read-failure-honesty.mjs.
Each key is '<path>#rule<N>' and its value is the number of occurrences that
existed when the guard was introduced (FINISHLINE C19/C20, 2026-08-06).
Counts may only SHRINK. A file NOT listed here must be at ZERO.
RULE 2 IS NOW EMPTY AND MUST STAY THAT WAY (FINISHLINE C20 sweep, 2026-08-08).
All 8 baselined RULE-2 queries were FIXED, not re-ratcheted:
app/assets/page.tsx                              (freshness rollup rendered 0)
lib/editors/lakehouse/lakehouse-editor-shell.tsx (bundle rendered as empty)
lib/editors/phase3/warehouse-editor.tsx          (DDL/dbt/starter queries vanished)
lib/editors/phase3/eventhouse-editor.tsx         (silent wrong-workspace navigation)
lib/editors/phase3/kql-database-editor.tsx       (silent wrong-workspace navigation)
lib/editors/phase4/data-agent-editor.tsx         (alert rules scoped to '')
lib/editors/powerplatform-editors.tsx            (bound app rendered as UNBOUND)
lib/panes/task-flows.tsx                         (item picker rendered empty)
Plus 7 more the OLD rule-2 resolver could not see AT ALL (inline-arrow queryFns,
and fetchers imported from outside lib/api/workspaces.ts): the four
finops-cockpit queries, admin-overview, admin-runtime-flags and semantic-model.
Every one now renders the SHARED <QueryErrorBar>
(apps/fiab-console/lib/components/ui/query-error-bar.tsx). RULE 2 exemptions
live in ALLOWLIST_RULE2 inside the guard, each with the MEASURED reason it
cannot mislead -- there are exactly two, and neither is 'not fixed yet'.
WHAT REMAINS BELOW IS RULE 1 ONLY (the C19 data-loss class: a discarded read
error in a file that can write that state back). It is a per-file ratchet that
may only shrink, and it was NOT weakened to let this sweep pass.
DELIBERATELY ABSENT (locked at zero -- reintroducing the bug there fails CI
immediately, which is the mutation proof this guard was accepted on):
lib/editors/phase4/fusion-sheet-editor.tsx
lib/editors/phase4/notepad-editor.tsx
lib/editors/phase4/analysis-board-editor.tsx
lib/editors/phase4/shared.tsx           (useItemState -- ~25 adopters)
lib/editors/geo-editors.tsx             (useGeoItemState -- 3 adopters)
lib/editors/sql-lab-editor.tsx
lib/editors/streaming-sql-editor.tsx
lib/editors/ducklake-catalog-editor.tsx
lib/editors/s3-gateway-editor.tsx
app/admin/catalog/page.tsx
... and EVERY file for rule 2, which now has no entries at all.
TO CLOSE ONE: fix the surface (adopt useItemDocState, or render the shared
<QueryErrorBar>), then DELETE or decrement its entry. A stale entry -- one with
no remaining occurrences -- is itself a failure, so the ratchet cannot silently
re-arm.
RULE 3 (the chokepoint check on the primitives) is never baselineable.
